notes.title: Banana Gine Will Be Paid!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve made the decision to change the distribution model of Banana Gine. Starting August 1, 2025, the game will transition to a paid model.[/p][p][/p][p]Players who downloaded the game for free before this date will retain full access, and it will remain in their library permanently at no additional cost.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your continued support.[/p]
